appName: AutoQA Studio — Autonomous AI-Powered Software Testing Platform
summary: Autonomous QA engineering platform that ingests web applications, codebases, ZIP archives, and requirements specs to discover DOM architecture, synthesize deterministic Playwright test suites, enforce human-in-the-loop review gating, execute test runs with trace telemetry, triage defect root causes, and export executive QA reports.

routes.name: Platform Shell & Workflow Wizard
routes.description: Main application shell with collapsible sidebar navigation, global top navigation bar, theme toggle, and 4-step linear QA workflow wizard.

interactiveElements.label: New Project CTA
interactiveElements.purpose: Opens new project onboarding wizard

interactiveElements.label: Global Search Trigger
interactiveElements.purpose: Opens Cmd+K search modal

interactiveElements.label: Theme Toggle
interactiveElements.purpose: Switches between dark (#0B1020) and light modes

interactiveElements.label: Sidebar Toggle
interactiveElements.purpose: Expands or collapses left sidebar navigation

potentialRisks: Unsaved session state loss on abrupt tab close
Theme flicker on initial cold load before localStorage read

routes.name: Step 1: New Project Onboarding
routes.description: Target web application ingestion form with URL format validation, project naming, environment target selection, and test credentials input.

interactiveElements.label: Target Application URL
interactiveElements.purpose: Receives target HTTP/HTTPS website URL

interactiveElements.label: Project Identifier Name
interactiveElements.purpose: Custom name for project

interactiveElements.label: Test Environment Dropdown
interactiveElements.purpose: Selects staging, production, or local server

interactiveElements.label: Credentials Toggle
interactiveElements.purpose: Enables username/password input fields

interactiveElements.label: Start Application Analysis Button
interactiveElements.purpose: Validates inputs and transitions to Step 2

potentialRisks: SSRF or malicious target URL injection
Network timeout during initial remote endpoint discovery

routes.name: Step 2: Application Analysis & Route Discovery
routes.description: Visualizes discovered application structure, routes, interactive DOM components, criticality ratings, and boundary risk scenarios with custom route additions.

interactiveElements.label: Generate Test Cases Button
interactiveElements.purpose: Synthesizes deterministic Playwright test cases and moves to Step 3

interactiveElements.label: Re-analyze Button
interactiveElements.purpose: Triggers fresh inspection scan on target

interactiveElements.label: Add Route Button
interactiveElements.purpose: Opens manual route ingestion form

potentialRisks: Route hierarchy mismatch on complex single-page micro-frontends
Omission of dynamically loaded modal dialogs from static route trees

routes.name: Step 3: Test Case Review & Approval Gate
routes.description: Human-in-the-loop review workspace allowing QA engineers to inspect test steps, assertions, priority, category, edit steps, and approve or reject test cases.

interactiveElements.label: Test Case Search Filter
interactiveElements.purpose: Filters test cases by ID, title, or requirement

interactiveElements.label: Bulk Approve Button
interactiveElements.purpose: Marks all unrejected test cases as approved

interactiveElements.label: Individual Approve Button
interactiveElements.purpose: Sets test case status to approved

interactiveElements.label: Individual Reject Button
interactiveElements.purpose: Sets test case status to rejected

interactiveElements.label: Edit Test Button
interactiveElements.purpose: Opens interactive test step editor

interactiveElements.label: Proceed to Execution Button
interactiveElements.purpose: Gated submission button active only when >=1 test is approved

potentialRisks: Execution of unverified or hallucinated test selectors without review
Approval bypass allowing unapproved tests to run

routes.name: Step 4: Test Execution & Evidence
routes.description: Interactive test execution workspace providing real-time run progress, step-by-step logs, live interactive DOM sandbox, defect root-cause triage, and report exports.

interactiveElements.label: Run Suite Button
interactiveElements.purpose: Initiates test runner execution across approved tests

interactiveElements.label: Defect Simulation Selector
interactiveElements.purpose: Injects deterministic defect scenarios (product bug, flaky selector, timeout)

interactiveElements.label: Export JSON Button
interactiveElements.purpose: Downloads full run results as structured JSON

interactiveElements.label: Export HTML Button
interactiveElements.purpose: Downloads standalone interactive HTML report

potentialRisks: Flaky selector false-positives under variable network conditions
DOM assertion race conditions on asynchronous hydration

routes.name: Executive Dashboard Overview
routes.description: High-level metrics dashboard showing total test counts, pass percentage rate, open defects, average step latency, recent project cards, and quick actions.

interactiveElements.label: Execute Suite Hero Button
interactiveElements.purpose: Quick-launches test execution

interactiveElements.label: Defect Triage Quick Action
interactiveElements.purpose: Navigates to defects view

interactiveElements.label: Traceability Quick Action
interactiveElements.purpose: Navigates to requirements matrix

interactiveElements.label: PDF Modal Quick Action
interactiveElements.purpose: Opens complete PDF export configuration modal

potentialRisks: Stale metric aggregation across asynchronously updated projects
Discrepancies in defect counters upon status transitions

routes.name: Defect Investigation & Root Cause Triage
routes.description: Categorizes test failures into Product Defects, Test Script Issues, and Environment Issues, providing AI/heuristic root cause analyses and code patches.

interactiveElements.label: Defect Search
interactiveElements.purpose: Filters defects by ID, title, or requirement

interactiveElements.label: Status Transition Dropdown
interactiveElements.purpose: Updates defect status between new, confirmed, in_progress, and fixed

interactiveElements.label: Copy Patch Button
interactiveElements.purpose: Copies suggested remediation code snippet to clipboard

potentialRisks: Misclassification of test harness flakiness as product defects
Unvalidated code patches applied without unit testing

routes.name: Requirements & ISO-29148 Traceability Matrix
routes.description: Bidirectional traceability matrix mapping customer user stories and specifications to test case coverage and active defect tickets.

interactiveElements.label: Requirement Search
interactiveElements.purpose: Filters requirements by code, title, or module

interactiveElements.label: Coverage Gaps Filter
interactiveElements.purpose: Isolates requirements with uncovered or partial test status

potentialRisks: Orphaned test cases lacking formal requirement identifiers
Incomplete coverage visibility on newly added features

routes.name: Platform & Runner Configuration
routes.description: Execution parameters, Playwright browser engine selection (Chromium, Firefox, WebKit), step timeouts, assertion thresholds, and data reset.

interactiveElements.label: Browser Engine Selector
interactiveElements.purpose: Sets default Playwright browser

interactiveElements.label: Action Timeout Field
interactiveElements.purpose: Sets milliseconds threshold for click/fill

interactiveElements.label: Save Settings Button
interactiveElements.purpose: Persists runner preferences in localStorage

interactiveElements.label: Reset Data Button
interactiveElements.purpose: Clears local storage test data

potentialRisks: Excessively short timeouts triggering spurious false-negative test failures
Accidental data loss via unconfirmed reset trigger

boundaryScenarios: Submitting URL with leading/trailing whitespaces, missing protocol, or unresolvable top-level domain
Bulk approving an empty test cases array without throwing null reference exceptions
Entering extreme numeric timeout values (0ms or 999999ms) in Runner Settings
Uploading zero-byte or corrupt non-ZIP binary file into the project onboarding dropzone
Submitting a 500-character project identifier name to verify UI truncation and layout resilience
Rapid consecutive double-clicks on 'Start Application Analysis' and 'Execute Suite' buttons
Attempting to proceed from Test Case Review to Execution when zero test cases are approved
